claims.statement: An energy audit has been mandatory in the reformed Czyste Powietrze programme since 31 March 2025, and the post-work energy standard must be evidenced by an energy certificate.
As of 13 March 2026, 1,401 municipalities, about 57% of Polish municipalities, acted as programme operators, and official operator help is free to residents.
Auditors and contractors will pay for pre-submission QA even though beneficiaries can obtain free official operator assistance.

contrary_evidence: S6 says official operators provide free help, which may eliminate consumer willingness to pay and reduce contractor demand.
Only municipalities and WFOŚiGW are official operators; a private product must not imply that status.
Programme rules and eligible measures can change, creating legal and maintenance risk.

economics.acquisition_route: Use de-identified historical packs from the family business and one collaborating auditor to build the checklist, then sell through regional auditor and contractor networks in Wielkopolska.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A versioned rule library and a consented taxonomy of real dossier defects could improve checking speed. Frequent programme changes are both the reason for the service and a maintenance cost; no moat is assumed from storing documents.
fingerprint.customer: Independent energy auditors and legitimate insulation, HVAC and heat-pump contractors preparing technical and commercial inputs for Czyste Powietrze applications; the product does not present itself as an official programme operator.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Use de-identified historical packs from the family business and one collaborating auditor to build the checklist, then sell through regional auditor and contractor networks in Wielkopolska.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: A document-ingestion QA tool reconciles audit recommendations, required energy standard, quantities, unit limits, equipment eligibility and quote fields, then returns traceable exceptions for a human professional to resolve. It is compliance support, not official operator service or an eligibility guarantee.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The auditor or contractor pays per checked dossier or a monthly team subscription when a report identifies exceptions and produces a versioned evidence checklist before submission.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An audit, scope, quote and equipment list have been assembled and need a rules, arithmetic and evidence check before the beneficiary works with the municipality or WFOŚiGW operator.

founder_fit: Family company can expose real workflow friction and supply a bounded pilot
Document extraction and deterministic checks fit AI-assisted data work
Per-dossier work can begin part-time with low capital
The founder can avoid acting as the public-facing salesperson or official adviser
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: Czyste Powietrze dossier QA for auditors and renovation contractors
uncertainties: Observed defect, correction and rejection rates in real dossiers
Which source documents are consistently available in machine-readable form
Whether auditors or contractors own the budget and perceive enough saved rework
Professional liability boundaries and required human review
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: With permission, blind-check 20 de-identified completed dossiers against the rule version that applied at submission, compare findings with actual correction requests, and then offer five paid prospective checks at a fixed fee. Stop if the tool cannot find material issues reliably or buyers prefer the free operator workflow.
